name: Kizhi Pogost
description: On Kizhi, a narrow island in Lake Onega in Russia's Karelia region, a cluster of wooden buildings rises behind a low fence. The 22-domed Transfiguration Church and the nine-domed Intercession Church, both from the 18th century, stand beside a wooden bell tower added in 1862. Their silvery domes crowd the skyline, and everything was built entirely of wood.
